race.comment: HOW COME (3) is yet to miss the placings in an excellent record this trip which boasts three wins. Recorded a 1.75 lengths win (19.44) in a OPEN last time at this track. Looks a leading chance on best. HARA'S NORTHERLY (1) was a last start winner (25.50) at Q Lakeside who is building a strong winning record. Got the money at his only try from this box. Significant danger. FRAGILE FRANKIE (8) is an honest type in the frame at 11 of 22 starts including last time when second (19.95) over 366m at this track. Has a good record at this journey. Has a good overall strike-rate and can find the frame here. REGAL WOLF (2) warrants respect although new to this track.
